**File:** `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/model/Owner.java` — `getCheckDigit()` (lines 425-453, `@Transient`, derived at read time).

@Transient
public Integer getCheckDigit() {
    if (this.customerCode == null) return null;
    int sum = 0; boolean dbl = true;
    for (int i = this.customerCode.length() - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
        char c = this.customerCode.charAt(i);
        if (c < '0' || c > '9') continue;
        int d = c - '0';
        if (dbl) { d *= 2; if (d > 9) d -= 9; }

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The optional courtesy title of the pet owner, one of MR, MRS, MS or DR.
            When present it prefixes the derived salutation.
          type: string
          example: DR
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner. On write the flat address is accepted
            for backward compatibility and used only when no structured addressLine1 is supplied.
            On read it is the composed, normalized address - the normalized addressLine1, with a
            single space and the normalized addressLine2 appended when an addressLine2 is present.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: The first line of the owner's structured postal address (street number and
            name). Preferred over the flat 'address' when present; normalized like the flat address
            (trim, collapse whitespace, upper-case, expand common street-type abbreviations).
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: The optional second line of the owner's structured postal address (unit,
            level, etc.). When present it is normalized and appended to the composed address.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Unit 4'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner. Stored in E.164 form; a leading
            '+' and country code are kept when present, otherwise country code '+61' is assumed
            and a single leading '0' is dropped from the national digits.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[0-9+()\-\s]*$'
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when present it must be a
            syntactically valid address and is stored lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: The owner's 4-digit postcode. Optional; when present it must be four
            digits and fall within the owner's city's region range (NSW 2000-2099,
            VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099). A city with no known region accepts any 4-digit
            postcode. Stored and returned when given.
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: The owner's date of birth, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. Optional. When present
            it drives the derived ageBand, computed against the owner's registrationDate.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the pet owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
            Optional on create; when omitted it defaults to the server's current date. The
            effective date must fall on a business day, so a Saturday or Sunday (whether supplied
            or defaulted) is rolled forward to the next Monday before it is stored.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: Write-only create directive. The householdId is computed from lastName and
            postcode, so this no longer forms the household link; it only bypasses the household
            duplicate block. When true, permits creating this owner as a declared member even though
            another owner already shares its lastName and postcode; otherwise such a request is
            rejected as a household duplicate.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: true
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: The canonical relative URL of this owner, '/api/owners/' followed by the
                owner's id.
              type: string
              example: /api/owners/1
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: The owner's salutation, derived at read time as the title, a single space
                and the lastName (e.g. 'DR Franklin'); just the lastName when no title is present.
              type: string
              example: DR Franklin
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: Franklin, George
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: G.F.
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: The owner's customer code, formatted '<LAST3>-<NNNN>' where LAST3 is the
                upper-cased first three letters of the last name and NNNN is a global 4-digit
                zero-padded sequence assigned at creation.
              type: string
              example: SMI-0007
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: A single Luhn check digit computed over the digits of the customerCode.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 4
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: A deterministic shared identifier, the first 12 hex characters of SHA-256
                over the owner's normalized lastName and postcode. Owners with the same lastName and
                postcode share it automatically; an owner with no postcode has no shared household
                and none.
              type: string
              example: 3f2504e04f89
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: The number of existing owners that shared this owner's firstName and
                lastName (compared case-insensitively) at the moment it was created.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: The owner's fiscal year, derived at read time from the business-day-adjusted
                registrationDate and formatted 'FY<YY>' where YY is the last two digits of the fiscal
                year. The fiscal year starts on 1 July and is named by the calendar year it ends in
                (e.g. a registrationDate of 14 Aug 2026 yields 'FY27').
              type: string
              example: FY27
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: The owner's membership number, formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>' where YY is
                the last two digits of the fiscal year (starting 1 July) derived from the
                business-day-adjusted registrationDate; the YY matches the fiscalYear. Assigned at
                creation.
              type: string
              example: SMI-0007-M27
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: The owner's membership points, derived at read time. Starts at 0; add 2
                when an email is present; add 1 when namesakeCount is 0; add 2 for a household of 3
                or more; add 3 when tenure (elapsed fiscal years since registrationDate, 1 July
                start) is one or more.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: The owner's membership level, a number from 1 to 4 derived at read time by
                banding membershipPoints - 1 (0-1 points), 2 (2-3), 3 (4-5), 4 (6 or more).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: The owner's region, derived at read time. The postcode is preferred - a
                4-digit postcode in a known region's range (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099,
                QLD 4000-4099) yields that region, disambiguating cities that share a name. When the
                postcode is absent or in no known range it falls back to the pinned city-to-region
                table (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD), or 'UNKNOWN' otherwise.
              type: string
              example: NSW
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: The owner's IANA timezone, derived at read time from the locality/region via
                the pinned region-to-timezone table (NSW->Australia/Sydney, VIC->Australia/Melbourne,
                QLD->Australia/Brisbane). Absent when the region is unknown.
              type: string
              example: Australia/Sydney
              readOnly: true
            ownerSegment:
              title: Owner segment
              description: The owner's segment, derived at read time and formatted '<TIER>_<AREA>' -
                one of 'PREMIUM_METRO', 'PREMIUM_REGIONAL', 'STANDARD_METRO' or 'STANDARD_REGIONAL'.
                TIER is 'PREMIUM' when membershipLevel is 3 or more, otherwise 'STANDARD'. AREA is
                'METRO' when the locality is a known region (NSW, VIC or QLD), otherwise 'REGIONAL'.
              type: string
              example: STANDARD_METRO
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: The stored E.164 telephone formatted for humans, derived at read time as
                the country code, a space, then the national digits grouped in threes
                (e.g. '+61 412 345 678'). The raw 'telephone' stays in E.164 form.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: The owner's preferred contact channel, derived at read time. 'EMAIL' when
                an email is present; otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              example: EMAIL
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: The owner's age band, derived at read time from birthDate against the
                registrationDate. 'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' from 18 to 64, 'SENIOR' at 65 or
                over. Absent when the owner has no birthDate.
              type: string
              example: ADULT
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: The single derived duplicate-detection key, the SHA-256 hex of
                'normalizedTelephone|lowerEmail|soundex(lastName)' (email empty when absent).
                All duplicate detection is expressed through this one key; a create whose whole
                identityKey equals an existing owner's is rejected with 409. Two members of the same
                household with different telephones have different identityKeys and are both allowed.
              type: string
              example: '3f2504e04f8931e39d64fb1a2f9c1e11c0ffee00c0ffee00c0ffee00c0ffee00'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:

              type: boolean

              type: boolean

              type: boolean

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The optional courtesy title of the pet owner, one of MR, MRS, MS or DR.
            When present it prefixes the derived salutation.
          type: string
          example: DR
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner. On write the flat address is accepted
            for backward compatibility and used only when no structured addressLine1 is supplied.
            On read it is the composed, normalized address - the normalized addressLine1, with a
            single space and the normalized addressLine2 appended when an addressLine2 is present.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: The first line of the owner's structured postal address (street number and
            name). Preferred over the flat 'address' when present; normalized like the flat address
            (trim, collapse whitespace, upper-case, expand common street-type abbreviations).
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: The optional second line of the owner's structured postal address (unit,
            level, etc.). When present it is normalized and appended to the composed address.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Unit 4'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner. Stored in E.164 form; a leading
            '+' and country code are kept when present, otherwise country code '+61' is assumed
            and a single leading '0' is dropped from the national digits.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[0-9+()\-\s]*$'
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when present it must be a
            syntactically valid address and is stored lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: The owner's 4-digit postcode. Optional; when present it must be four
            digits and fall within the owner's city's region range (NSW 2000-2099,
            VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099). A city with no known region accepts any 4-digit
            postcode. Stored and returned when given.
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: The owner's date of birth, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. Optional. When present
            it drives the derived ageBand, computed against the owner's registrationDate.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the pet owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
            Optional on create; when omitted it defaults to the server's current date. The
            effective date must fall on a business day, so a Saturday or Sunday (whether supplied
            or defaulted) is rolled forward to the next Monday before it is stored.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: Write-only create directive. The householdId is computed from lastName and
            postcode, so this no longer forms the household link; it only bypasses the household
            duplicate block. When true, permits creating this owner as a declared member even though
            another owner already shares its lastName and postcode; otherwise such a request is
            rejected as a household duplicate.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: true
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: The canonical relative URL of this owner, '/api/owners/' followed by the
                owner's id.
              type: string
              example: /api/owners/1
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: The owner's salutation, derived at read time as the title, a single space
                and the lastName (e.g. 'DR Franklin'); just the lastName when no title is present.
              type: string
              example: DR Franklin
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: Franklin, George
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: G.F.
              readOnly: true
            memberId:
              title: Member id
              description: The owner's unified member id, formatted '<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>' - the
                region code, the 2-digit fiscal year, the 8 upper-case hex HASH8 (SHA-256 over the
                normalized telephone and last name) and a single Luhn check digit CHK over the digits
                of '<REGION><FY><HASH8>'. Assigned at creation.
              type: string
              example: NSW271A2B3C4D5
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: A deterministic shared identifier, the first 12 hex characters of SHA-256
                over the owner's normalized lastName and postcode. Owners with the same lastName and
                postcode share it automatically; an owner with no postcode has no shared household
                and none.
              type: string
              example: 3f2504e04f89
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: The number of existing owners that shared this owner's firstName and
                lastName (compared case-insensitively) at the moment it was created.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: The owner's fiscal year, derived at read time from the business-day-adjusted
                registrationDate and formatted 'FY<YY>' where YY is the last two digits of the fiscal
                year. The fiscal year starts on 1 July and is named by the calendar year it ends in
                (e.g. a registrationDate of 14 Aug 2026 yields 'FY27').
              type: string
              example: FY27
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: The owner's membership number, formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>' where YY is
                the last two digits of the fiscal year (starting 1 July) derived from the
                business-day-adjusted registrationDate; the YY matches the fiscalYear. Assigned at
                creation.
              type: string
              example: SMI-0007-M27
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: The owner's membership points, derived at read time. Starts at 0; add 2
                when an email is present; add 1 when namesakeCount is 0; add 2 for a household of 3
                or more; add 3 when tenure (elapsed fiscal years since registrationDate, 1 July
                start) is one or more.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: The owner's membership level, a number from 1 to 4 derived at read time by
                banding membershipPoints - 1 (0-1 points), 2 (2-3), 3 (4-5), 4 (6 or more).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: The owner's region, derived at read time. The postcode is preferred - a
                4-digit postcode in a known region's range (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099,
                QLD 4000-4099) yields that region, disambiguating cities that share a name. When the
                postcode is absent or in no known range it falls back to the pinned city-to-region
                table (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD), or 'UNKNOWN' otherwise.
              type: string
              example: NSW
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: The owner's IANA timezone, derived at read time from the locality/region via
                the pinned region-to-timezone table (NSW->Australia/Sydney, VIC->Australia/Melbourne,
                QLD->Australia/Brisbane). Absent when the region is unknown.
              type: string
              example: Australia/Sydney
              readOnly: true
            ownerSegment:
              title: Owner segment
              description: The owner's segment, derived at read time and formatted '<TIER>_<AREA>' -
                one of 'PREMIUM_METRO', 'PREMIUM_REGIONAL', 'STANDARD_METRO' or 'STANDARD_REGIONAL'.
                TIER is 'PREMIUM' when membershipLevel is 3 or more, otherwise 'STANDARD'. AREA is
                'METRO' when the locality is a known region (NSW, VIC or QLD), otherwise 'REGIONAL'.
              type: string
              example: STANDARD_METRO
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: The stored E.164 telephone formatted for humans, derived at read time as
                the country code, a space, then the national digits grouped in threes
                (e.g. '+61 412 345 678'). The raw 'telephone' stays in E.164 form.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: The owner's preferred contact channel, derived at read time. 'EMAIL' when
                an email is present; otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              example: EMAIL
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: The owner's age band, derived at read time from birthDate against the
                registrationDate. 'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' from 18 to 64, 'SENIOR' at 65 or
                over. Absent when the owner has no birthDate.
              type: string
              example: ADULT
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: The single derived duplicate-detection key, the SHA-256 hex of
                'normalizedTelephone|lowerEmail|soundex(lastName)' (email empty when absent).
                All duplicate detection is expressed through this one key; a create whose whole
                identityKey equals an existing owner's is rejected with 409. Two members of the same
                household with different telephones have different identityKeys and are both allowed.
              type: string
              example: '3f2504e04f8931e39d64fb1a2f9c1e11c0ffee00c0ffee00c0ffee00c0ffee00'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: True when more than 80 owners had already been created for this owner's
                registration business day at the moment it was created; otherwise false. Evaluated
                and fixed at creation.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            capacityWarning:
              title: Capacity warning
              description: True when this owner's city already held between 40 and 49 owners at the
                moment it was created - approaching the per-city capacity limit of 50; otherwise
                false. Evaluated and fixed at creation.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: True when this owner is not a hard duplicate but, at creation, shared an
                existing owner's lastName and postcode while having a different telephone; otherwise
                false. Evaluated and fixed at creation.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: The id of the existing owner this one possibly duplicates (matching
                lastName and postcode with a different telephone). Present only when
                possibleDuplicate is true.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            deleted:
              title: Deleted
              description: Whether this owner has been soft-deleted. A DELETE retains the record and
                sets this true; a newly created owner is false. Deleted owners are still readable but
                are ignored by the create endpoint's duplicate/identity checks.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:

## Summary

I unified `customerCode` and `membershipNumber` into a single `memberId` formatted `<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>`, and removed the standalone `checkDigit` field.

**Changes made:**

1. **`model/Owner.java`** — Removed the `customerCode`/`membershipNumber` columns, their getters/setters, and the derived `getCheckDigit()`. Added a stored `member_id` column with `getMemberId()`/`setMemberId()`. Repointed `getPrimaryIdentifier()` to return the memberId.

2. **`AssignMemberId.java`** (new, replacing `AssignCustomerCode.java`) — Computes `memberId` = region + 2-digit fiscal year + 8 upper-hex SHA-256 of `telephone+lastName` + a Luhn CHK over the digits of `<REGION><FY><HASH8>`. Collision de-duplication now applies to the memberId (append `-<n>`). Deleted `AssignMembershipNumber.java`.

3. **`owners.POST.yml`** — Renamed the `customerCode` step to `memberId` (wired `AssignMemberId`, placed after registration-date defaulting so FY is available) and removed the `membershipNumber` step.

4. **`AuditOwnerCreated.java`** — The audit line and the structured `OWNER_CREATED` JSON event now reference `memberId` (via `getPrimaryIdentifier()`) instead of the removed fields.

5. **`OwnerMapper.java`** — Swapped the ignore-mappings for the removed fields to `memberId`.

6. **`openapi.yml`** — Removed the `customerCode`, `checkDigit`, and `membershipNumber` schema properties; added a `memberId` property (drives the generated DTO).

7. **`schema.sql`** (hsqldb, h2, mysql, postgres) — Renamed `customer_code` → `member_id` and dropped `membership_number`.

Sample audit output confirms the format, e.g. `memberId=NSW271B92F1FC9` (NSW + FY 27 + HASH8 `1B92F1FC` + CHK `9`).
